title: Nexus: First Steps
summary: Set up the first safe Nexus loop before widening the route.

blocks.title: Start Small
blocks.body: Carry a scanner, clear your exit route, and read every tooltip before using a suspicious Nexus object. Never test a new anomaly while overburdened.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: A safe Nexus start is a scan, a clear exit, an empty-enough inventory, and the discipline to delay activation until you understand the risk.

blocks.title: Before You Expand
blocks.body: Name the goal, the exit, and the resource or signal that proves Nexus is helping. If any of those are vague, keep the next run shorter.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
